verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ וְיָרָבְעָ֛ם עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לְהַקְטִֽיר׃ בָּ֧א אִ֣ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִיהוּדָ֛ה אֶל־ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh wə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lə·haq·ṭîr bā ’îš ’ĕ·lō·hîm mî·hū·ḏāh ’el- bêṯ- ’êl biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Suddenly as Jeroboam was standing beside the altar to burn incense there came a man of God from Judah to vvv Bethel by the word of the LORD

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מִזְבֵּ֣חַ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ כֹּ֖ה יְהוָ֑ה אָמַ֣ר הִנֵּֽה־ בֵ֞ן שְׁמ֔וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ נוֹלָ֤ד לְבֵית־ דָּוִד֙ עָלֶ֗יךָ אֶת־ וְזָבַ֣ח כֹּהֲנֵ֤י הַבָּמוֹת֙ הַמַּקְטִרִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אָדָ֖ם וְעַצְמ֥וֹת יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh way·yō·mer miz·bê·aḥ miz·bê·aḥ kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nêh- ḇên šə·mōw yō·šî·yā·hū nō·w·lāḏ lə·ḇêṯ- dā·wiḏ ‘ā·le·ḵā ’eṯ- wə·zā·ḇaḥ kō·hă·nê hab·bā·mō·wṯ ham·maq·ṭi·rîm ‘ā·le·ḵā ’ā·ḏām wə·‘aṣ·mō·wṯ yiś·rə·p̄ū ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: And he cried out against the altar by the word of the LORD O altar O altar this is what the LORD says . . . A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David and upon you - he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you and human bones will be burned upon you

verses.original: הַה֤וּא בַּיּ֨וֹם וְנָתַן֩ מוֹפֵת֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֑ה דִּבֶּ֣ר זֶ֣ה הַמּוֹפֵ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִנֵּ֤ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ נִקְרָ֔ע הַדֶּ֥שֶׁן אֲשֶׁר־ עָלָֽיו׃ וְנִשְׁפַּ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm wə·nā·ṯan mō·w·p̄êṯ lê·mōr Yah·weh dib·ber zeh ham·mō·w·p̄êṯ ’ă·šer hin·nêh ham·miz·bê·aḥ niq·rā‘ had·de·šen ’ă·šer- ‘ā·lāw wə·niš·paḵ
verses.literal: That day [the man of God] gave a sign saying The LORD has spoken this sign - Surely the altar will be split apart and the ashes - upon it will be poured out

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ יָרָבְעָ֧ם אֶת־ מֵעַ֥ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֔ל כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ דְּבַ֣ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים קָרָ֤א עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יָד֛וֹ לֵאמֹ֣ר׀ תִּפְשֻׂ֑הוּ יָדוֹ֙ שָׁלַ֣ח אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו וַתִּיבַ֤שׁ יָכֹ֖ל וְלֹ֥א לַהֲשִׁיבָ֥הּ אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ’eṯ- mê·‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl ḵiš·mō·a‘ də·ḇar ’ă·šer ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm qā·rā ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw lê·mōr tip̄·śu·hū yā·ḏōw šā·laḥ ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw wat·tî·ḇaš yā·ḵōl wə·lō la·hă·šî·ḇāh ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Now when King - Jeroboam - who was at the altar in Bethel heard the word that the man of God had cried out against [it] he stretched out his hand and said Seize him But the hand he stretched out - toward him withered so that he could not pull it back . . .

verses.original: וְהַמִּזְבֵּ֣חַ נִקְרָ֔ע הַדֶּ֖שֶׁן וַיִּשָּׁפֵ֥ךְ מִן־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כַּמּוֹפֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים נָתַ֛ן בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·miz·bê·aḥ niq·rā‘ had·de·šen way·yiš·šā·p̄êḵ min- ham·miz·bê·aḥ kam·mō·w·p̄êṯ ’ă·šer ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm nā·ṯan biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh
verses.literal: And the altar was split apart and the ashes poured out - - according to the sign that the man of God had given by the word of the LORD

verses.original: הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ וַיַּ֨עַן אֶל־ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים חַל־ נָ֞א אֶת־ פְּנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ וְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲדִ֔י יָדִ֖י וְתָשֹׁ֥ב אֵלָ֑י אִישׁ־ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ וַיְחַ֤ל פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ יַד־ וַתָּ֤שָׁב אֵלָ֔יו וַתְּהִ֖י כְּבָרִֽאשֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer way·ya·‘an ’el- ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥal- nā ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·hiṯ·pal·lêl ba·‘ă·ḏî yā·ḏî wə·ṯā·šōḇ ’ê·lāy ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- way·ḥal pə·nê Yah·weh ham·me·leḵ yaḏ- wat·tā·šāḇ ’ê·lāw wat·tə·hî kə·ḇā·ri·šō·nāh
verses.literal: Then the king . . . responded to the man of God Intercede . . . - with the LORD your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored - So the man of God - interceded with the LORD and the king’s hand was restored to him as [it was] before

verses.original: הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים בֹּאָה־ הַבַּ֖יְתָה אִתִּ֥י וּֽסְעָ֑דָה וְאֶתְּנָ֥ה לְךָ֖ מַתָּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ way·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bō·’āh- hab·bay·ṯāh ’it·tî ū·sə·‘ā·ḏāh wə·’et·tə·nāh lə·ḵā mat·tāṯ
verses.literal: Then the king said to the man of God Come home with me and refresh yourself and I will give you a reward

verses.original: אִישׁ־ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אִם־ תִּתֶּן־ לִי֙ אֶת־ חֲצִ֣י בֵיתֶ֔ךָ לֹ֥א אָבֹ֖א עִמָּ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ אֹ֤כַל לֶ֙חֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶשְׁתֶּה־ מַּ֔יִם הַזֶּֽה׃ בַּמָּק֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer ’im- tit·ten- lî ’eṯ- ḥă·ṣî ḇê·ṯe·ḵā lō ’ā·ḇō ‘im·māḵ wə·lō- ’ō·ḵal le·ḥem wə·lō ’eš·teh- ma·yim haz·zeh bam·mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: But the man of God . . . . . . replied If you were to give me - half your possessions I still would not go with you nor would I eat bread . . . or drink water in this place

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֵ֣ן׀ צִוָּ֣ה אֹתִ֗י בִּדְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹא־ תֹ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁתֶּה־ מָּ֑יִם וְלֹ֣א תָשׁ֔וּב בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽכְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵên ṣiw·wāh ’ō·ṯî biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh lê·mōr lō- ṯō·ḵal le·ḥem wə·lō ṯiš·teh- mā·yim wə·lō ṯā·šūḇ bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer hā·lā·ḵə·tā
verses.literal: For this is what I was commanded - by the word of the LORD . . . You must not eat bread . . . or drink water . . . or return by the way - you came

verses.original: וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֵ֑ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ וְלֹֽא־ שָׁ֣ב בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֛ר בָּ֥א בָ֖הּ אֶל־ בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥêr bə·ḏe·reḵ wə·lō- šāḇ bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer bā ḇāh ’el- bêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: So [the man of God] went another way and did not return by the way - he had come to vvv Bethel

verses.original: אֶחָד֙ זָקֵ֔ן וְנָבִ֤יא יֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֑ל בְנ֡וֹ וַיָּב֣וֹא וַיְסַפֶּר־ ל֣וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ עָשָׂה֩ הַיּ֜וֹם בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֗ל אֶת־ וַֽיְסַפְּר֖וּם לַאֲבִיהֶֽם׃ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥāḏ zā·qên wə·nā·ḇî yō·šêḇ bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl ḇə·nōw way·yā·ḇō·w way·sap·per- lōw ’eṯ- kāl- ham·ma·‘ă·śeh ’ă·šer- ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ā·śāh hay·yō·wm bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl ’eṯ- way·sap·pə·rūm la·’ă·ḇî·hem had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer dib·ber ’el- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Now a certain old prophet was living vvv in Bethel and his sons came and told him - all the deeds that the man of God had done that day vvv in Bethel - They also told their father the words that [the man] had spoken to the king

verses.original: אֵֽי־ זֶ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ הָלָ֑ךְ אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר אֲלֵהֶם֙ בָנָ֗יו אֶת־ וַיִּרְא֣וּ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֖א מִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê- zeh had·de·reḵ hā·lāḵ ’ă·ḇî·hem way·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem ḇā·nāw ’eṯ- way·yir·’ū had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer hā·laḵ ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- bā mî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Which . . . way did he go their father asked - And his sons - showed him the way - taken by the man of God who had come from Judah

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ בָּנָ֔יו חִבְשׁוּ־ הַחֲמ֑וֹר לִ֖י וַיַּחְבְּשׁוּ־ הַחֲמ֔וֹר ל֣וֹ וַיִּרְכַּ֖ב עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- bā·nāw ḥiḇ·šū- ha·ḥă·mō·wr lî way·yaḥ·bə·šū- ha·ḥă·mō·wr lōw way·yir·kaḇ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: So [the prophet] said to his sons Saddle the donkey for me Then they saddled the donkey for him and he mounted it

verses.original: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיִּ֨מְצָאֵ֔הוּ יֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּ֣חַת הָאֵלָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו הַאַתָּ֧ה אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אתָ מִֽיהוּדָ֖ה אָֽנִי׃ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rê ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yim·ṣā·’ê·hū yō·šêḇ ta·ḥaṯ hā·’ê·lāh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ha·’at·tāh ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- bā·ṯā mî·hū·ḏāh ’ā·nî way·yō·mer
verses.literal: and went after the man of God He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked . . . Are you the man of God who came from Judah I [am] he replied

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו לֵ֥ךְ הַבָּ֑יְתָה אִתִּ֖י וֶאֱכֹ֖ל לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw lêḵ hab·bā·yə·ṯāh ’it·tî we·’ĕ·ḵōl lā·ḥem
verses.literal: So [the prophet] said to [the man of God] Come home with me and eat some bread

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֹ֥א אוּכַ֛ל לָשׁ֥וּב אִתָּ֖ךְ וְלָב֣וֹא אִתָּ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ אֹ֣כַל לֶ֗חֶם וְלֹֽא־ אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה מַ֔יִם אִתְּךָ֙ הַזֶּֽה׃ בַּמָּק֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō ’ū·ḵal lā·šūḇ ’it·tāḵ wə·lā·ḇō·w ’it·tāḵ wə·lō- ’ō·ḵal le·ḥem wə·lō- ’eš·teh ma·yim ’it·tə·ḵā haz·zeh bam·mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: But [the man] replied I cannot . . . go home . . . . . . with you and I will not eat bread . . . or drink water with you in this place

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֵלַי֙ דָבָ֤ר בִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לֹֽא־ תֹאכַ֣ל לֶ֔חֶם וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׁתֶּ֥ה מָ֑יִם לֹא־ שָׁ֖ם תָשׁ֣וּב הָלַ֥כְתָּ בָּֽהּ׃ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ לָלֶ֔כֶת
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ê·lay ḏā·ḇār biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh lō- ṯō·ḵal le·ḥem wə·lō- ṯiš·teh mā·yim lō- šām ṯā·šūḇ hā·laḵ·tā bāh bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- lā·le·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: For I have been told by the word of the LORD You must not eat bread . . . or drink water . . . there or return . . . by the way - you came

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אֲנִ֣י גַּם־ נָבִיא֮ כָּמוֹךָ֒ וּמַלְאָ֡ךְ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלַי֩ בִּדְבַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר הֲשִׁבֵ֤הוּ אִתְּךָ֙ אֶל־ בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ וְיֹ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם וְיֵ֣שְׁתְּ מָ֑יִם כִּחֵ֖שׁ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’ă·nî gam- nā·ḇî kā·mō·w·ḵā ū·mal·’āḵ dib·ber ’ê·lay biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh lê·mōr hă·ši·ḇê·hū ’it·tə·ḵā ’el- bê·ṯe·ḵā wə·yō·ḵal le·ḥem wə·yê·šət mā·yim ki·ḥêš lōw
verses.literal: Then [the prophet] replied . . . I too [am] a prophet like you and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD saying Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water The old prophet was lying to him

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שָׁב אִתּ֗וֹ וַיֹּ֥אכַל לֶ֛חֶם בְּבֵית֖וֹ וַיֵּ֥שְׁתְּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ ’it·tōw way·yō·ḵal le·ḥem bə·ḇê·ṯōw way·yê·šət mā·yim
verses.literal: but the man of God went back with him ate bread in his house and drank water

verses.original: הֵ֥ם יֹשְׁבִ֖ים אֶל־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֑ן פ וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיְהִ֕י אֶל־ הַנָּבִ֖יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֱשִׁיבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm yō·šə·ḇîm ’el- haš·šul·ḥå̄n p̄ way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’el- han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer hĕ·šî·ḇōw
verses.literal: While they were sitting at the table . . . the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֞א אֶל־ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤א מִֽיהוּדָה֙ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֵאמֹ֔ר יַ֗עַן כִּ֤י מָרִ֙יתָ֙ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַ֙רְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ צִוְּךָ֖
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’el- ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- bā mî·hū·ḏāh kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh lê·mōr ya·‘an kî mā·rî·ṯā pî Yah·weh wə·lō šā·mar·tā ’eṯ- ham·miṣ·wāh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ṣiw·wə·ḵā
verses.literal: and the prophet cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah This is what . . . the LORD says Because . . . you have defied the word of the LORD and have not kept - the commandment that the LORD your God gave you

verses.original: וַתָּ֗שָׁב וַתֹּ֤אכַל לֶ֙חֶם֙ וַתֵּ֣שְׁתְּ מַ֔יִם בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־ תֹּ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם וְאַל־ תֵּ֣שְׁתְּ מָ֑יִם נִבְלָתְךָ֖ לֹֽא־ תָב֥וֹא אֶל־ קֶ֥בֶר אֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·šāḇ wat·tō·ḵal le·ḥem wat·tê·šət ma·yim bam·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer dib·ber ’ê·le·ḵā ’al- tō·ḵal le·ḥem wə·’al- tê·šət mā·yim niḇ·lā·ṯə·ḵā lō- ṯā·ḇō·w ’el- qe·ḇer ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: but you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so . . . . . . . . . . . . your body shall never reach . . . the tomb of your fathers

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֛י אָכְל֥וֹ לֶ֖חֶם וְאַחֲרֵ֣י שְׁתוֹת֑וֹ לַנָּבִ֖יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֱשִׁיבֽוֹ׃ וַיַּחֲבָשׁ־ הַחֲמ֔וֹר ל֣וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê ’ā·ḵə·lōw le·ḥem wə·’a·ḥă·rê šə·ṯō·w·ṯōw lan·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer hĕ·šî·ḇōw way·ya·ḥă·ḇāš- ha·ḥă·mō·wr lōw
verses.literal: And after [the man of God] had finished eating - and drinking the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him

verses.original: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ אַרְיֵ֛ה וַיִּמְצָאֵ֧הוּ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ וַיְמִיתֵ֑הוּ נִבְלָתוֹ֙ וַתְּהִ֤י מֻשְׁלֶ֣כֶת בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְהַחֲמוֹר֙ עֹמֵ֣ד אֶצְלָ֔הּ וְהָ֣אַרְיֵ֔ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֵ֥צֶל הַנְּבֵלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ’ar·yêh way·yim·ṣā·’ê·hū bad·de·reḵ way·mî·ṯê·hū niḇ·lā·ṯōw wat·tə·hî muš·le·ḵeṯ bad·de·reḵ wə·ha·ḥă·mō·wr ‘ō·mêḏ ’eṣ·lāh wə·hā·’ar·yêh ‘ō·mêḏ ’ê·ṣel han·nə·ḇê·lāh
verses.literal: As he went on his way a lion met him on the road and killed him and his body was left lying in the road with the donkey - - and the lion standing beside [it]

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֣ים עֹבְרִ֗ים וַיִּרְא֤וּ אֶת־ הַנְּבֵלָה֙ מֻשְׁלֶ֣כֶת בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְאֶת־ הָ֣אַרְיֵ֔ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֵ֣צֶל הַנְּבֵלָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ בָעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֛ר הַזָּקֵ֖ן הַנָּבִ֥יא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’ă·nā·šîm ‘ō·ḇə·rîm way·yir·’ū ’eṯ- han·nə·ḇê·lāh muš·le·ḵeṯ bad·de·reḵ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·yêh ‘ō·mêḏ ’ê·ṣel han·nə·ḇê·lāh way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·ḏab·bə·rū ḇā·‘îr ’ă·šer haz·zā·qên han·nā·ḇî yō·šêḇ bāh
verses.literal: And there were men passing by who saw - the body lying in the road with the lion standing beside it and they went and reported this in the city where the old prophet lived

verses.original: הַנָּבִיא֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱשִׁיב֣וֹ מִן־ הַדֶּרֶךְ֒ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ ה֔וּא אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָרָ֖ה אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יְהוָ֜ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֨הוּ לָאַרְיֵ֗ה וַֽיִּשְׁבְּרֵ֙הוּ֙ וַיְמִתֵ֔הוּ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּר־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer hĕ·šî·ḇōw min- had·de·reḵ way·yiš·ma‘ way·yō·mer hū ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer mā·rāh ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh Yah·weh way·yit·tə·nê·hū lā·’ar·yêh way·yiš·bə·rê·hū way·mi·ṯê·hū kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber- lōw
verses.literal: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard this he said It [is] the man of God who disobeyed - the command of the LORD Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion and it has mauled him and killed him according to the word that the LORD - had spoken to him

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־ בָּנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חִבְשׁוּ־ אֶֽת־ הַחֲמ֑וֹר לִ֖י וַֽיַּחֲבֹֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’el- bā·nāw lê·mōr ḥiḇ·šū- ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·mō·wr lî way·ya·ḥă·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: Then the old prophet instructed . . . his sons . . . Saddle - the donkey for me So they saddled [it]

verses.original: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיִּמְצָ֤א אֶת־ נִבְלָתוֹ֙ מֻשְׁלֶ֣כֶת בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וַֽחֲמוֹר֙ וְהָ֣אַרְיֵ֔ה עֹמְדִ֖ים אֵ֣צֶל הַנְּבֵלָ֑ה הָֽאַרְיֵה֙ אֶת־ לֹֽא־ אָכַ֤ל הַנְּבֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א שָׁבַ֖ר אֶֽת־ הַחֲמֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ way·yim·ṣā ’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯōw muš·le·ḵeṯ bad·de·reḵ wa·ḥă·mō·wr wə·hā·’ar·yêh ‘ō·mə·ḏîm ’ê·ṣel han·nə·ḇê·lāh hā·’ar·yêh ’eṯ- lō- ’ā·ḵal han·nə·ḇê·lāh wə·lō šā·ḇar ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·mō·wr
verses.literal: and he went and found - the body lying in the road with the donkey and the lion standing beside [it] The lion - had not eaten the body . . . or mauled - the donkey

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֜יא אֶת־ וַיִּשָּׂ֨א נִבְלַ֧ת אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים וַיַּנִּחֵ֥הוּ אֶֽל־ הַחֲמ֖וֹר וַיְשִׁיבֵ֑הוּ הַזָּקֵ֔ן הַנָּבִ֣יא וַיָּבֹ֗א אֶל־ עִיר֙ לִסְפֹּ֖ד וּלְקָבְרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî ’eṯ- way·yiś·śā niḇ·laṯ ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yan·ni·ḥê·hū ’el- ha·ḥă·mō·wr way·šî·ḇê·hū haz·zā·qên han·nā·ḇî way·yā·ḇō ’el- ‘îr lis·pōḏ ū·lə·qā·ḇə·rōw
verses.literal: So the old prophet - lifted up the body of the man of God laid it on the donkey and brought it back to his own - - - city to mourn for him and bury him

verses.original: וַיַּנַּ֥ח אֶת־ נִבְלָת֖וֹ בְּקִבְר֑וֹ וַיִּסְפְּד֥וּ עָלָ֖יו ה֥וֹי אָחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yan·naḥ ’eṯ- niḇ·lā·ṯōw bə·qiḇ·rōw way·yis·pə·ḏū ‘ā·lāw hō·w ’ā·ḥî
verses.literal: Then he laid - the body in his own tomb and they lamented over him Oh my brother

verses.original: וַיְהִי֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י קָבְר֣וֹ אֹתוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ בָּנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּמוֹתִי֙ וּקְבַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ֔י בַּקֶּ֕בֶר אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים קָב֣וּר בּ֑וֹ הַנִּ֖יחוּ עַצְמֹתָ֔יו אֶת־ אֵ֚צֶל עַצְמֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê qā·ḇə·rōw ’ō·ṯōw way·yō·mer ’el- bā·nāw lê·mōr bə·mō·w·ṯî ū·qə·ḇar·tem ’ō·ṯî baq·qe·ḇer ’ă·šer ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm qā·ḇūr bōw han·nî·ḥū ‘aṣ·mō·ṯāw ’eṯ- ’ê·ṣel ‘aṣ·mō·ṯāy
verses.literal: - After he had buried him - [the prophet] said to his sons . . . When I die you must bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried Lay my bones - beside his bones

verses.original: כִּי֩ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרָא֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְעַל֙ כָּל־ בָּתֵּ֣י הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעָרֵ֥י שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ הָיֹ֨ה יִהְיֶ֜ה
verses.transliteration: kî had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer qā·rā biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl wə·‘al kāl- bāt·tê hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·‘ā·rê šō·mə·rō·wn hā·yōh yih·yeh
verses.literal: for the message that he cried out by the word of the LORD against the altar - vvv in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places - in the cities of Samaria will surely come to pass . . .

verses.original: אַחַר֙ הַזֶּ֔ה הַדָּבָ֣ר יָרָבְעָ֖ם לֹֽא־ שָׁ֥ב הָרָעָ֑ה מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ וַ֠יָּשָׁב וַיַּ֜עַשׂ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י בָמ֔וֹת מִקְצ֤וֹת הָעָם֙ יְמַלֵּ֣א אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ הֶֽחָפֵץ֙ וִיהִ֖י כֹּהֲנֵ֥י בָמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥar haz·zeh had·dā·ḇār yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām lō- šāḇ hā·rā·‘āh mid·dar·kōw way·yā·šāḇ way·ya·‘aś kō·hă·nê ḇā·mō·wṯ miq·ṣō·wṯ hā·‘ām yə·mal·lê ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw he·ḥā·p̄êṣ wî·hî kō·hă·nê ḇā·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Even after these events Jeroboam did not repent of his evil ways but again he appointed priests for the high places from every class of people He ordained - - anyone who desired to be a priest of the high places

verses.original: הַזֶּ֔ה וַיְהִי֙ בַּדָּבָ֣ר לְחַטַּ֖את בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֑ם וּלְהַכְחִיד֙ וּלְהַשְׁמִ֔יד מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh way·hî bad·dā·ḇār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ bêṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ū·lə·haḵ·ḥîḏ ū·lə·haš·mîḏ mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: And this was . . . the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its extermination and destruction from the face of the earth
